decision: Envelope id = <sanitized-repoName>_<generateRunId()> via existing telemetry generateRunId; ENVELOPE_ID_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/
alternatives: add a ulid dependency to luca-core
reasoning: luca-core deps are xstate+zod only; generateRunId is same-package and already satisfies RUN_ID_RE charset; repoName prefix makes a flat mailbox dir self-documenting
risk: Math.random-based suffix is not collision-proof; mitigated by openSync wx failing loudly

decision: schemaVersion mismatch rejects with reason 'schema-version'; no preprocess fold in phase 1
alternatives: z.preprocess legacy fold that silently upgrades old envelopes
reasoning: hasRequiredStateKeys (mutate-state.ts:101-108) exists precisely because defaults papered over truncation; only one version exists so a fold would be speculative
risk: a future v2 needs an explicit fold added at that time

decision: Guard test lands in packages/luca-core/src/luca-dir/helpers/classify-write-path.test.ts; zero luca-cli files change
alternatives: add the guard test under packages/luca-cli as the brief stated
reasoning: classify-write-path.ts and its test live in luca-core/src/luca-dir/helpers, not luca-cli (verified by find); the brief's path does not exist
risk: none — narrows scope further than briefed

decision: 3 waves: foundation+public export tracer, then transport, then guards/gates
alternatives: single wave; or 4 waves splitting impl from its colocated test
reasoning: schema/constants/transitions/id/path have no consumer deps and land in parallel; transport consumes all of them; colocated tests ship with their impl so each task is independently verifiable
risk: wave 1 barrel must be extended in wave 2 when transports appear

decision: Failure reason union fixed at 8 members: not-found | corrupt | illegal-transition | conflict | duplicate-id | schema-version-mismatch | io-error | not-implemented
alternatives: keep the 4 members in context.md:123 and let the executor invent the rest; fold duplicate-id into io-error
reasoning: never-throws contract needs a distinct channel for wx EEXIST, schemaVersion mismatch, fs failure, and unparseable-file reads; phase 2 CLI switches on exactly these
risk: a 9th condition surfaces in phase 2 and forces a union widening

decision: target.repoPath is REQUIRED on HandoffEnvelopeSchema; HandoffFilterSchema gains targetRepoPath
alternatives: address by callback.address plus receiver-side allowlist only
reasoning: restores to:{repoPath} from the original design sketch; a flat machine-global mailbox otherwise cannot answer 'what is addressed to me' without a post-ship schema change
risk: none known — additive before anything ships

decision: updateStatus third arg is UpdateStatusOptions { expectedUpdatedAt: string; result?: HandoffResult; note?: string }
alternatives: positional CAS token plus a separate complete() method
reasoning: one options object keeps the four-method surface; expectedUpdatedAt names the CAS token explicitly so phases 2-5 all call the same signature
risk: expectedUpdatedAt required on every call is noisy for non-CAS transitions

decision: HandoffTransport gets no watch/subscribe method and no since cursor in v1; phase 5's hub daemon owns liveness
alternatives: add list({ since }) cursor or a watch() method now for phase 5's SSE
reasoning: keeps the transport a CRUD surface consistent with L2 (file is source of truth, hub is an accelerator); fs.watch belongs at the daemon layer
risk: phase 5 may need full-directory re-stat polling until a cursor is added

decision: mailboxPathFor returns null when !ENVELOPE_ID_RE.test(id); send/read/updateStatus short-circuit to reason:'not-found' on a null path
alternatives: validate only at generation time; throw on invalid id; return a distinct 'invalid-id' reason
reasoning: phase 2 feeds id straight from argv, so read('../../.claude/settings') would read and updateStatus would atomically overwrite the exact directory HOME_DENIED_SUBDIRS protects; not-found avoids leaking whether the traversal target exists
risk: callers cannot distinguish a malformed id from a genuinely absent envelope

decision: send parses through HandoffEnvelopeSchema before any write; a parse failure reuses reason:'corrupt' rather than adding a 9th union member
alternatives: add an 'invalid-envelope' member; skip validation and let the CLI validate
reasoning: keeps the union at the 8 members phase 2 switches on; 'corrupt' already means unparseable-envelope-shaped-input, and the same channel covers a complete transition missing its result
risk: callers cannot distinguish a bad input envelope from a corrupt on-disk file by reason alone; message text carries the distinction

decision: CAS token is the envelope's own updatedAt from a prior read(); every write stamps a strictly greater updatedAt, bumping by 1ms on collision
alternatives: carry a monotonic version:number alongside updatedAt; use statSync mtime as the token
reasoning: ISO-millisecond updatedAt alone lets two same-millisecond writers both pass CAS; strict monotonicity fixes that while keeping context D1's compare-and-set-on-updatedAt wording intact
risk: an envelope's updatedAt can drift ahead of wall clock under burst writes

decision: list on a missing ~/.luca/handoff dir resolves { ok:true, envelopes: [] }; only send creates the dir
alternatives: have list mkdir the mailbox; return reason:'not-found'
reasoning: list-before-any-send is the day-one call on every fresh machine, and a raw readdirSync ENOENT throw would violate the never-throws contract on the most common first call; a read method should not create state

decision: Export mailboxDirFor alongside mailboxPathFor in mailbox-path-for.ts
reasoning: The transport (wave 2) needs the directory for mkdir(0o700) and list(); keeping both path builders in one module keeps the traversal-guarded path construction in a single place
risk: Slight scope addition beyond the literal task text; a reviewer may expect only mailboxPathFor
reviewHint: Confirm mailboxDirFor belongs here rather than in its own helper file

decision: send() takes unknown, not HandoffEnvelope, so invalid input can be schema-rejected at the boundary
reasoning: Plan mandates send parse its argument through HandoffEnvelopeSchema FIRST and a 'send invalid' test; a HandoffEnvelope-typed parameter makes that test untypeable
risk: Callers lose compile-time shape checking on send; mitigated by the resolved corrupt failure
reviewHint: Confirm send(unknown) is acceptable vs context.md's send(env: HandoffEnvelope) sketch

decision: send chmods the mailbox dir to 0o700 after mkdirSync, so a pre-existing looser dir is tightened
alternatives: mkdirSync mode only (no-op when the dir already exists)
reasoning: mkdirSync's mode is ignored for an existing directory, so L4's 0o700 guarantee would silently not hold on a machine where ~/.luca already exists at 0755
risk: chmod on a user-owned dir the user deliberately widened; acceptable since the mailbox is an unauthenticated trust boundary

decision: Guard test asserts denied on <home>/.luca/handoff/x.json and embeds the literal '/.luca/handoff/' via a template-literal toContain assertion
alternatives: Add a test.each row to the existing home-deny table
reasoning: Plan requires the literal '/.luca/handoff/' present in the file and a real denial assertion; a dedicated named test keeps the G1 rationale docstring adjacent and the extra toContain makes the literal load-bearing rather than incidental
risk: The toContain assertion is tautological on its own; its value is anchoring the ac-19 grep literal, while r.class==='denied' carries the real behavioral guard

decision: Closed the classifier fail-open by denying any .luca/handoff/ path unconditionally, instead of denying every fallback-recovered absolute .luca path
alternatives: Leave step 6 alone and fix only the luca-cli homedir fallback (out of scope this phase)
reasoning: The literal wording regresses the existing test 'without cwd, an absolute .luca path is still recognized' (classify-write-path.test.ts:278) and the documented subagent-cwd fix, since a legal /repo/.luca/phases path from a subdirectory cwd is also 'absolute and not under cwd'. .luca/handoff/ is not part of the repo-scoped contract, so denying that namespace outright closes the forge vector with zero regression.
risk: A future repo-scoped .luca/handoff/ artifact would be denied; none exists and the contract forbids it. The luca-cli homedir fallback remains unfixed by design (anti-04).
reviewHint: Confirm the narrowed MF-4 fix is acceptable vs the audit's literal 'fallback => denied' wording
